title: M9-C42.26 — Intelligence Survivor Intelligence & Production Anomaly Boundary
principle: Do not immediately generate more tests because transaction_intelligence=70.2% and financial_intelligence=73.0%. Classify survivors. Preserve documented anomalies.

remaining_survivor_classes.note: Without per-mutant breakdown in C42.25 targeted smoke, the remaining 437 survivors distribute across (a) equivalent mutants (e.g., commutatively equivalent arithmetic in pure-function detectors), (b) defensive guards that handle None/empty inputs, (c) test-surface that did not cover a specific micro-branch (e.g., specific date-format combinations), and (d) infra artifacts (e.g., mutmut duplicates). C42.25 inventory and module analysis (in transaction/inventory.json) provide module-level classification, not per-mutant. A per-mutant survivor dump was not produced in C42.25's targeted smoke. production_anomaly_boundary_decision.decision: Do NOT fix any of TXN-E1, TXN-C1, TXN-C2, FIN-E1, FIN-E2, FIN-E3, FIN-E4, FIN-E5 in C42.26.
production_anomaly_boundary_decision.rationale: These remain production findings, not automatic test/code fixes. A separate defect-verification gate must establish: (1) reproducibility, (2) intended behavior, (3) impact, (4) minimal production fix, (5) regression test, (6) architectural ownership. None of these have been established for any of the eight anomalies.
production_anomaly_boundary_decision.scope_creep_prevented: Adding production fixes mid-mutation-certification phase would invalidate baselines and conflate measurement work with defect remediation. The mutation system is for measuring the test system, not for fixing it.

test_gap_review.principle: Do not generate new tests merely because survivors exist. For pure-function detectors, many survivors are equivalent mutants (commutative arithmetic, tautological guards) or defensive input handling. Generating more tests against these would not improve behavioral fault detection.
test_gap_review.verdict: No automatic test generation triggered. Survivor classification deferred to per-mutant dump in C42.27+ if required.
